developersOffer.introTitle: From library records to your application
developersOffer.introBody: Build directories, research tools and local discovery experiences with published public library data.
developersOffer.discover: Search by text, place and filters
developersOffer.retrieve: Retrieve library records with cursor-based pagination
developersOffer.attribute: Keep source credits and licences with every record
developersOffer.exampleNote: Example only. Live requests need an active subscription and a server-side API key. Documentation is free to explore.
developersOffer.detailsTitle: Billing, spending limits and who can subscribe
developersOffer.title: API Access
developersOffer.priceNote: Stripe confirms the final charge, including any local tax, before you pay. Billed monthly; cancel at any time, effective at the end of the paid period.
developersOffer.period: Your billing period follows your subscription: the first period starts when payment is confirmed and comes with the full allowance.
developersOffer.signIn: Sign in to buy API access
developersOffer.overageTitle: Overage is off unless you switch it on
developersOffer.overageUnavailable: Overage is unavailable. Requests stop with a clear error when an included allowance is used up, until the next paid period. Failed or refused requests are never charged.
developersOffer.overageBody: An Organiser can opt in and choose a monthly cap from {capMin} to {capMax} before tax ({capDefault} is suggested). Above the included allowance:
developersOffer.overageMib: {mibPrice} per extra MiB of response data
developersOffer.overageStop: Without overage, or once the cap is reached, requests stop with a clear error until the next period. Failed or refused requests are never charged.
developersOffer.whoBody: Anyone with a verified email address. Buying for yourself? We set up a free organisation with you as its Organiser, so you can add colleagues later. In an existing organisation, an Organiser buys for everyone; members can view usage.
developersOffer.reachBonus: Organisers with active API Access also get more Reach in the Atlas: {perHour} new calculations an hour, up to {perDay} a day for the account, and service Reach across up to {libraries} libraries.
developersOffer.independence: An API key identifies your application, not a person. It never grants library editing, staff verification or a better place in search results.

teamApiSubscription.title: Add API access
teamApiSubscription.description: Connect {team}’s applications to published library search and records.
teamApiSubscription.taxDetail: Tax is included in this base GBP price. Stripe confirms the amount at checkout.
teamApiSubscription.unavailable: API purchasing is currently unavailable. Please try again later.
teamApiSubscription.allowance: Included in each paid billing period
teamApiSubscription.consent: I agree to the <membership>API purchase terms</membership>, <refunds>cancellation and refund policy</refunds>, and the API limits shown here, and request access as soon as payment is confirmed.
teamApiSubscription.billedTo: Billed monthly to {owner}. Cancel at any time from billing management; it takes effect at the end of the paid period.
teamApiSubscription.periodNoOverage: The period follows your paid subscription: the first starts when payment is confirmed and has the full allowance. Overage is unavailable. Requests stop when an included allowance is used up; failed or refused requests are never charged.
teamApiSubscription.periodAndOverage: The period follows your paid subscription: the first starts when payment is confirmed and has the full allowance. Overage is off by default. An Organiser can opt in later with a monthly cap of {capMin} to {capMax} before tax, at {request} per extra request, {mib} per extra MiB and {credit} per extra analysis credit. Without overage, requests stop when an allowance is used up.

teamApiKeys.intro: Use a separate key for each application. Keys can only read published library data.

teamApiKeys.permissionsHelp: Choose the access this application needs.
teamApiKeys.searchHelp: Find libraries by text, place and filters.
teamApiKeys.recordsHelp: Read published details for a library.
teamApiKeys.secretHelp: The secret is shown once. Copy it after creation and keep it in your application server’s environment.

apiOverage.title: Overage and next invoice
apiOverage.projectedEnding: Accrued overage only; your subscription will not renew.
apiOverage.projectedRenewing: Next month’s subscription (tax included) plus this period’s overage. Stripe adds any tax due on overage and confirms the final amount.
apiOverage.rates: Beyond the included allowance: {request} per successful request, {mib} per MiB of response data (measured from total excess bytes) and {credit} per completed analysis credit. The cap covers all three together, before tax. Refused, failed and timed-out work is never billed.
apiOverage.capReached: Further paid usage is stopped until the next period or a higher cap. Charges already accrued remain on your next invoice.
apiOverage.capBelowAccrued: This cap is below the overage already accrued. Further paid usage will stop; accrued charges stay on your invoice.
apiOverage.consent: I agree to pay for usage beyond the included allowance at the rates above, up to {cap} a month before tax, billed with the next monthly invoice.
apiOverage.organisersOnly: Organisers choose whether to allow overage and its cap.
apiOverage.inactive: Overage can be turned on while API access is active.
apiOverage.unavailable: Overage is not available yet. Requests stop when an allowance is used up.
